role: Exploratory follow-up registered after reading the primary candidate and enabled forced-choice results. All fixed sources and both wordings retained. No tuning.
question: Does the frozen scalar retrieval ordering preserve explicit direction judgments when the very same Agent input and pre-answer hidden state are used?
design: Replay the enabled historical Agent on both real views and the identical two options in each of their two orders. Take the final layer pre-answer state at the position that produced the letter logits. Require the original saved logits and the direct language-head recomputation from that state to agree. Feed exactly the same hidden into the frozen CUP with the same pixels, score the same two text alternatives. For CUP average raw original-oriented sentence margins over the two option orders (unchanged sentence identities); for the explicit head reverse the sign for swapped letter slots. Save each underlying embedding, state and score. Retain natural single-condition diagnostics, including gray reference in the supporting choice test.
interpretation: Tests the deployed hidden-to-CUP retrieval pipeline on choice-prompt states. The downstream head and scoring task differ from letter classification; does not localize loss specifically to the projection layer. It is a mechanism check, not ordinary query-independent deployment.
